title: PosBulkScheduleOverrideStatus

job_id.description: A value that identifies a bulk schedule override request.

processing_complete.description: True if this job processing is done (successful or not), false otherwise.

status.description: The final status of the operation - SUCCESSFUL / FAILED.

reason.description: Additional details that pertain to the status of the override.

entity_override_results.description: A list of each entity and its individual override status (specific configurations are required to enable this).

merchant_id.description: This field can either be the Grubhub ID for the merchant, or if an external ID is provided, it represents the external ID of the merchant.

description: Describes the state (completed or not) of a bulk schedule override operation request together with its state (successful or not).

entity_index.description: The index of the entity in the original list of IDs as it was sent to Grubhub.

entity_id.description: Either the menu entity internal (Grubhub) OR external (Partner) IDs.

status.description: Status of the override operation for this entity.

details.description: Additional details that pertain to the the individual entity's status.

BulkProcessingItemEntityStatus.description: An individual override entity and its status.
